geometry/background_evolution: Scale factor, conformal time and comoving Hubble radius of flat de Sitter space.
geometry/horizon_crossing: Horizon crossing $k/(aH)=1$ for three wavenumbers, in e-folds and in conformal time.
geometry/expansion_truncation_errors: Truncation error of the inverse-metric and $\sqrt{-g}$ expansions: slopes $1,2,3$ confirm correct order.
geometry/curvature_sign_check: Ricci scalar from the symbolic engine; a flipped Riemann sign is detected.
gauge/gauge_comparison: One scalar perturbation in three gauges: $A$ and $\psi$ change; Bardeen potentials do not.
perturbations/svt_diagnostics: Spectral SVT round trip, transversality of the TT part, small-$k$ error amplification.
dynamics/mode_evolution: Tensor mode amplitude and oscillation versus $x=k/(aH)$: decay inside, freeze-out outside.
dynamics/formulation_comparison: Four formulations of the mode equation agree to the solver tolerance.
dynamics/phase_space_and_wronskian: Canonical phase space, mode function and Wronskian conservation.
spectra/tensor_spectrum: Tensor power spectrum at fixed conformal time versus k, numerical vs exact.
spectra/late_time_freezeout: Freeze-out of the tensor spectrum; departure is $x^2$.
spectra/initial_state_dependence: Excited initial states and finite-start-time error as a Bogoliubov mixing.
validation/residual_diagnostics: ODE residual of the stored solution is set by interpolation error (4th order).
validation/tolerance_and_horizon_crossin: Error tracks $\mathrm{rtol}$ and does not spike at horizon crossing.
validation/solver_methods_and_order: Solver comparison and fixed-step RK4 order-of-convergence study.
